### 🟢 Approval recommended No active review issues are recorded for the change handling VirusTotal reports that omit SHA-256. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR This PR fixes VirusTotal file enrichment failing when a report omits `sha256`, allowing the remaining enrichment steps to continue. **Changes:** - Falls back to the observable’s known SHA-256 when the response lacks one. - Skips indicator creation and logs the lookup hash when neither source provides SHA-256. - Adds regression tests for both fallback and skip behavior. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `internal-enrichment/​virustotal/​tests/​tests_virustotal/​test_virustotal.py` | Tests missing-SHA-256 handling and continued label updates. | | `internal-enrichment/​virustotal/​src/​virustotal/​processors/​file.py` | Adds defensive SHA-256 selection and warning-based indicator skipping. |
Review effort: Balanced
